1.reason: by design: the coordinator ruled the batching pin compares crossing and non-crossing owner calls in one process, because a stored 1e-12 reference is CPU-family bound (8.5e-12 Gold vs Broadwell); the compact arm against the stored control pins changes common to both paths

findings.text: The census assertion was changed from the independent constant 1696 to len(actual) == len(expected) > 0, and both sides now call the same production _mesh on the same outlines, so any change in cell count or polygon partition moves both sides together and the test cannot see it.

The batch-edges expected value is a second call to iron.linear_galerkin_cell_interaction in the same process, so that arm guards batching-only regressions only; it cannot detect a change common to both quadrature paths, which the separate compact arm against the stored control is what pins.
